text:
leo: heads-up — setting up a 1-week shadow/oncall rotation next Mon-Fri to onboard two new engineers (jyoti & tasha). want to nail the handoff protocol and make sure no coverage gaps across PST/EET. please read and reply with availability. :wave:

jyoti: thx leo. rough ask — i'll shadow primary for the morning (PST) and then pair with secondary for evenings. what's the expected overlap window for handoffs?

leo: ideal overlap = 30m. practical minimum = 15m. handoff checklist is below — use it as guide and add any missing bits.

ops-docs-bot: new runbook update available: https://internal.redwood/intra/runbooks/oncall-handoff (v3.2). highlights: explicit primary->secondary page format, incident-bot ack command, and customer-impact matrix.

sam: copying the checklist here so it's easy to follow during shadowing:
```
ONCALL HANDOFF CHECKLIST (compact)
1) Primary: brief active incidents + state
2) Run through open alerts and tolerances (grafana links)
3) Share recent deploys & rollout IDs (if within last 2h)
4) Confirm paging rules (sev/impact) and escalation tree
5) Confirm expected overlap & next check-in time
6) Secondary: ack and repeat back "I understand"
7) Update the ticket/incidence channel with "handoff complete" tag
```

leo: also note paging policy snippet — please follow exactly: page oncall when either:
- customer-facing latency > 30s on production endpoints OR
- error-rate > 5% sustained for 5min OR
- degrade in embeddings job throughput affecting >1 customer job

patrick: small question — for borderline cases (e.g., 4.9% errors), should we still page or first DM the primary?

jyoti: i'd prefer DM first if it's nonblocking and no active incidents. page if user-facing errors or spikes.

sam: agreed. default to paging if in doubt during business hours. outside business hours page for anything that looks like customer impact.

incident-bot: NOTICE: Recent page created — INC-2026 at 2114999800: Hosted API high tail latency (> 40s) for region us-west-2. Impact: intermittent 502s to compactor service.

leo: that INC just got resolved but it's a good live example for the new shadows. primary (sam) — can you run through how you handled it in the handoff tomorrow?

sam: sure — i'll walk through the timeline and the three quick mitigation steps I ran: 1) rollback small rollout, 2) restart compactor nodes, 3) enable degraded fallback to quantized model. will prep a short slide.

tasha: i can take the evening shadow on Tue/Thu PST next week. can someone confirm timezone conversions for my calendar?

jyoti: tasha — Tue 18:00 PST = Wed 03:00 CET. i can do overlap for Tue evening to Wed morning.

leo: current schedule proposal (please ack):
- Mon: primary sam, secondary patrick, shadow jyoti (08:00-17:00 PST)
- Tue: primary lea (floating), secondary sam, shadow tasha (17:30-21:30 PST) <-- gap: 21:30-00:00 PST needs cover
- Wed: primary patrick, secondary sam, shadow jyoti (08:00-17:00 PST)
- Thu: primary sam, secondary patrick, shadow tasha (17:30-21:30 PST)
- Fri: primary patrick, secondary sam, shadow jyoti (08:00-17:00 PST)

patrick: i can pick up Tue 21:30-23:30 PST to close the gap.

leo: awesome. add to calendar and set reminder to run through the runbook during first shadow handoff.

jyoti: quick note on escalation steps (for shadows): if primary doesn't respond within 10m after page, escalate to secondary. if still no response after 10m, page leads@redwood and follow emergency dialing procedure in runbook.

ops-docs-bot: snippet from runbook (pager commands):
```
# ack page
/ack INC-<id> --user <your-name> --note "taking over"
# escalate
/escalate INC-<id> --to secondary
```

tasha: should shadows practice using /ack during the shadow shift?

sam: yes — everyone shadows should perform a fake page flow during first shift (we'll simulate with incident-bot in the staging channel). takes 5-10m.

leo: final ask: everyone, before your first shadow shift, please: 1) confirm MFA & VPN access, 2) verify you can see oncall dashboards, 3) join the staging incident drill tomorrow 09:30 PST.

jyoti: confirmed MFA & dashboards. i'll be on the drill.

tasha: VPN done, need help with dashboard perms. pinging @ops-docs-bot for link.

ops-docs-bot: dashboard perm request: https://internal.redwood/permissions/request — select "oncall-shadow" template.

patrick: cheers. i'll take Tue late and walk through the escalation during the drill.

leo: perfect. if anyone sees any holes in the checklist please add here. otherwise i'll post the calendar invites and the handoff doc v1.

sam: looks good. :thumbsup:

jyoti: thanks — excited to shadow and learn the live mitigation flow.

incident-bot: DRILL: staging page will be triggered at 2115000300 in #eng-oncall-staging — please join to practice /ack flows.
